release.name: v0.11.0
release.body:
## Contents

Each tarball contains `bin/` with all mallcop binaries:

- `baseline` — baseline engine + CLI
- `detector-*` — 13 security detectors
- `mallcop` — customer scan CLI
- `mallcop-finding-context` — WorkContext builder with injection defense
- `notify-{telegram,slack,teams,email}` — delivery channels

## Install

```bash
# Download (replace PLATFORM with linux-amd64, linux-arm64, or darwin-arm64)
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/releases/download/v0.11.0/mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/releases/download/v0.11.0/mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz.sha256
sha256sum -c mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz.sha256
tar xzf mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz
ls bin/
```

### Features

- feat(migrate): `mallcop migrate` upgrades an existing deploy repo in place (mallcoppro-973) (#163)

### Other

- backlog: default→triage (2b9), lookup_rules metadata schema (118), github_actor degrade (2a9), SHA-pin actions (796) (#164)

---

**Full changelog**: [`v0.10.1...v0.11.0`](https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/compare/v0.10.1...v0.11.0)

release.name: mallcop-ops v0.1.0
release.body:
First public release of `mallcop-ops` — the mallcop self-extension operator CLI (`selfext --run` / `--propose` / `--scaffold-gha`).

Built from mallcop-pro @41201e4cd4d8 (includes the CODE-lane fixes that reach a GREEN gate: GLM-5.2 code model + `--code-model`, opencode config `limit.context/output`, scenario exemplars, and the `corpus.pin` trusted regen). Each tarball bundles the binary under `bin/` plus the pricing/models/lanes `config/`.

Verify: `sha256sum -c mallcop-ops-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz.sha256`.

- `mallcop` — customer scan CLI

## Install

```bash
# Download (replace PLATFORM with linux-amd64, linux-arm64, or darwin-arm64)

tar xzf mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz
ls bin/
```

### Features

- feat(config): shared mutation primitive + `mallcop config set` (mallcoppro-2df) (#149)
- feat(config): autonomy dial — strict non|semi|fully enum, default propose-only (mallcoppro-315) (#148)

### Fixes

- fix(test): make mallcop-exam-report cf-create deterministic across fresh checkouts (mallcoppro-649) (#147)
- fix(cli): harden scan.yml template — runner-arch asset resolution, GOFLAGS=-mod=mod sidecar build (mallcoppro-977) (#146)

---

**Full changelog**: [`v0.8.0...v0.9.0`](https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0)

## Migration note (v0.8.0 -> v0.9.0)
`learning.autonomy` is now a strict enum: `non` | `semi` | `fully` (default `non`, propose-only). Configs written by v0.8.0 used `autonomy: "off"` — edit that line to `non` (or rerun `mallcop config set autonomy non`) before upgrading, or the config will fail strict decode with a loud error.
